title: Implement governance adoption preview review and apply
goal: Prepare and locally apply exact provenance-bound .guard governance candidates without combining Init, consumer trust-change or remote activation.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview classifies exact .guard operations and historical adoption provenance without mutating TargetRoot.
Apply requires the accepted preview hash and unchanged Target snapshot and writes only .guard.
Links collisions stale previews and paths outside .guard fail closed.
An external receipt and exact recovery artifact preserve prior Target bytes.
No real consumer workflow PR ruleset or remote state changes occur.
risks: A local apply engine could be mistaken for authorization to change a consumer.
Historical adoption data could accidentally become active authority.
decisions: Confine active governance to .guard and keep history non-authoritative.
